summary: Backend-only smoke test of Iteration 5 (product-brand incentives + cumulative unpaid report + xlsx export). All 7 review targets pass. Config migration confirmed (43 product_incentives across 11 brands, retail_commission_pct=0). Daily incentives now include product_incentive field; jahangir on 2026-06-28 shows db=700, pi=300, rc=0, total=1000 as expected. Product-incentive rule engine matches correctly across Kerastase / Olaplex / Guinot slabs / Thalgo. Cumulative report returns 12 unpaid-staff rows with all required fields; xlsx export works with 'Summary' and 'Day-wise Unpaid' sheets. Payout confirmation correctly excludes confirmed (staff,date) from subsequent unpaid report (jahangir 06-28 removed, paid_days_count=1). Monthly & manager milestone regressions return 200.
